name: Monthly client report
description: From month end to the monthly SEO report landing in the client's inbox, as Hana Iqbal and Owen Hart describe it.

sources.title: Tidewater interview: Hana Iqbal, account manager
Tidewater interview: Owen Hart, SEO specialist

steps.name: Month end
steps.notes: The first working day after the month closes starts it; nobody has to ask.

steps.name: Pull ranking data
steps.notes: Owen mostly, Priti when Owen is slammed. Spread over the first three or four days of the month, not all on day one. Owen corrected himself: first "An hour, yeah", then "Well no, with the checking it's three hours a client"; the export itself is an hour and the rest is checking. A big e-commerce client is nearer four. The export times out about once a fortnight and is rerun for that client.

hands_on_hours.speaker: Hana Iqbal
hands_on_hours.quote: Give or take, but about an hour a client.

hands_on_hours.speaker: Owen Hart
hands_on_hours.quote: Well no, with the checking it's three hours a client.

steps.name: Technical check
steps.notes: Hana did not mention this step; Owen runs a crawl on each site and reads the errors, broken links and page speed so the report has more than rankings. The crawl runs on its own but he has to read it. It comes after the rankings and before the commentary; he drops a paragraph into the commentary doc.

hands_on_hours.speaker: Owen Hart
hands_on_hours.quote: About an hour and a half per client.

steps.name: Write commentary
steps.notes: Two hours for a quiet month, three if something has dropped. Written one at a time or in a batch ("it's a mess"). Hana has a wish for a commentary template, not how it works today.

waiting_now.speaker: Hana Iqbal
waiting_now.quote: I've got four half-written right now

steps.name: Director review
steps.notes: Callum reads every report in the doc, changes wording and sometimes queries a number. Hana does not know how long it takes ("You'd have to ask him. It can't be long, he reads fast.", 00:02:56). It sits in his inbox a day or two because he is in meetings: queueing behind his other work, not a fixed wait. Sent back for tone or a weak recommendation; the numbers do not change.

rework_rate.speaker: Owen Hart
rework_rate.quote: Callum bounces about half of them back.

steps.name: Send report
steps.notes: Export to PDF, email it, a quick note.

hands_on_hours.speaker: Hana Iqbal
hands_on_hours.quote: A quarter of an hour, tops.

steps.name: Follow-up call
steps.notes: Hana does not say who takes the call; Account manager is taken from her sending the report. Sometimes it runs over.

hands_on_hours.speaker: Hana Iqbal
hands_on_hours.quote: it's half an hour in the diary.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: ninety per cent finished once it's sent.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: But about one in ten has questions, and then it turns into a follow-up call.

proposals.title: The rank tracker export times out and the client's pull is redone
proposals.detail: About once a fortnight. Hana would not guess the cost; Owen put it at maybe twenty minutes each time, unmeasured.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: It times out about once a fortnight and then Owen has to redo the whole client.

evidence.speaker: Owen Hart
evidence.quote: Maybe twenty minutes each time, but I haven't measured it.

proposals.title: Every report goes through Callum
proposals.detail: Reports queue in his inbox for a day or two behind meetings; Hana says it is not slowness but that he is one person and everything goes through him.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: he's one person and everything goes through him.

proposals.title: The same commentary sentences are rewritten every month
proposals.detail: Hana calls a template a wish, not how it works today; Owen would use one too.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: I write the same sentence about mobile visibility every month.

truths.text: Reports go out within five working days of month end.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: it's in the retainer terms. Report within five working days of month end.

requirements.text: Callum reviews every report before it goes out.

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: He reviews every report before it goes out.

requirements.assumed: Hana does not say who set the rule; Callum is named as the person who does the review.

measures.text: Report within five working days of month end

evidence.speaker: Hana Iqbal
evidence.quote: Report within five working days of month end.
